Kai: FYI customer reported transient double confirmed lines after a resume+toolcall flow at 11:02 UTC.

Meera: can you paste trace/session and a one-line timeline?

Kai: trace=tr_x77, session=s_11. Short timeline: stream prefix ~100 tokens -> disconnect -> client resume -> router handoff -> toolcall during resume -> EOF -> ledger produced two provisional claims with same prefix hash, two confirms, then downstream reconcile merged to one (refund).

Jon: router probably lost parent_provisional header during handoff. quick fix options: (A) router forward headers (longish), (B) ledger coalesce on confirm by prefix-hash within 10s, tombstone extras with suppress_refund, (C) console collapse provisional rows and show "merged" badge.

Meera: prefer B+C as low-risk quick wins. Ledger coalesce needs CAS on provisional-hash to avoid concurrent confirms. Also include merged_ids in confirmed metadata.

Kai: agreed. UX: collapse provisional duplicates in console and show tooltip "These provisional charges were merged during reconciliation" linking to trace. Also add a console filter to hide provisional rows.

Jon: implementation plan: I'll prototype confirm-coalesce PoC in ledger; Meera adds unit tests for race cases; Kai will draft console change. Schedule canary to us-west low-traffic.

ConsoleBot: Canary scheduled: ledger/confirm-coalesce -> 2026-05-02T02:00Z (canary: us-west).

Meera: I'll open PRs and post links here.

Kai: thanks all, please tag if you add metrics (provisional_merge_rate, transient_confirm_rows).
